title: DocuSign expires at 5 p.m.
scenario: You receive an e-signature notice for a contract you expected, and the email says the envelope expires at 5 p.m. The link opens a login screen asking for your Microsoft credentials before showing the document.

answers.A: Contact the sender through the existing business thread or contract system to confirm the envelope.
answers.B: Use the email link because you were expecting the contract and the deadline is real.
answers.C: Open the e-signature service or contract system independently and locate the expected document there.

explanation: Expected documents make credential phishing more effective. The contract can be verified through the platform or sender without trusting the email link.
proTip: Expected content does not authenticate the delivery path.
